status: FROZEN comparator for Amendment G scientific gate; never refit after the Phase 1 freeze
recipe: nfl_yardage_v2 feature set (v2.FEATURES) and v2.PARAMS (XGBoost reg:absoluteerror); features computed by nfl_yardage_v3.Replayer from the stats files and the raw schedule (spread/total are v2 inputs; used only here)
training_period: rows 2023 + 2024 wk1-12 (history from 2022); early stopping on 2024 wk13-18; nothing later
point_output: booster prediction (raw, may be negative); v2_frozen_comparator.point_floored = max(point,0)
residual_distribution: empirical residuals (actual - prediction) on 2024 wk13-18; distribution = max(point + residual, 0); stored as 99-point quantile grid

eligibility.candidate_team: team of the player's most recent game before the target week (v2 recipe has no roster input); players whose team changed since their last game are v2-abstentions (deterministic, recorded as player_absent_from_v2_candidate_set)
eligibility.rush_yds: position RB/FB, >=3 prior games, mean carries last 3 >= 5
eligibility.rec_yds: position WR/TE/RB, >=3 prior games, mean targets last 3 >= 3

conditional_on_participation: v2 rows are conditional on the player having played; the comparison to Phase 1 is conditional on actual participation (as in Phase 1C)

comparator_policy.v2_frozen_comparator: this manifest's frozen artifacts; the ONLY v2 used by the Amendment G scientific gate
comparator_policy.v2_live_production: nfl_models/nfl_yardage_v2_work production artifacts (trained through 2025), point only, hashes recorded per record; operational context only, never used by a gate; may change when production is retrained
comparator_policy.matching: nfl_phase1e_v2.match: key (game_id, player_id, outcome, horizon, cutoff); deterministic, sorted, independent of input order
